entry.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / stylized-concept
Asset type: NO RETURNS Cinder warehouse entrance appearance proposal, one widescreen image.
Image 1 is the current Unity gray warehouse camera view and is the layout constraint. Image 2 is the established palette/style reference ONLY; do not copy its narrow outdoor alley or clutter.
Primary request: paint the warehouse in image 1 with a practical PSX industrial space-delivery appearance. Keep camera angle, central opening edges, visible room depth, rear opening, flat floor elevation and ceiling envelope aligned with image 1. Current room floor is 14.4 by 20.4 meters, wall height 4m, entrance clear opening 3.2 by 3.3m; dimensions are constraints, not text to print. Do not shrink the warehouse to a corridor.
Materials: large quiet ivory panels, one rust-red horizontal band aligned across wall modules, dark graphite frame within the existing frame volume, calm dark-gray floor with broad panel seams, ivory ceiling underside with sparse joints. Very limited coarse wear near bases and touched edges; broad surfaces mostly clean, no all-over speckle or photorealistic grime. Angular low-poly shapes, flat matte shading, restrained pixel texture appearance consistent with a PSX game.
Presentation: one compact warm-amber rectangular work light above the entrance, contained in the upper frame area; small wall sign beside the entrance; one empty two-shelf open cargo rack placed against an interior side wall away from the doorway and walking line. The distant rear doorway remains visible. Rack uses rust-red uprights and dark shelf surfaces, no boxes.
Text verbatim on sign: "WAREHOUSE" with a simple directional arrow toward the entrance. No other printed words, UI, title, HUD, dimension labels, or tiny gray-scene development markers.
Lighting: enough ambient illumination to distinguish floor and cargo routes; warm light anchors the entrance without glare. Avoid bloom, shiny reflections, depth of field, fog, cinematic black crush, extra pipes, beams hanging below the existing ceiling, new doors, thresholds, characters, creatures, crates or new equipment.
Output is an appearance concept, not a validated game screenshot. Preserve architectural proportions strongly.

components.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Cinder warehouse 8-unit production appearance reference sheet, a readable wide 4-column by 2-row board.
Image 1: actual gray structural models; use their simple silhouettes, not their arbitrary exploded arrangement. Image 2: newly generated entrance appearance proposal; match ONLY its ivory panels, continuous rust-red band, matte graphite framing, subdued floor and warm amber lamp.
Create exactly eight numbered component cells: 1 FLOOR, 2 WALL, 3 DOOR FRAME, 4 CEILING / BEAM, 5 CORNER / END, 6 LAMP, 7 SIGN, 8 EMPTY RACK.
Each cell has a large clear isometric primary view plus small front/back/side/top visual reference views where useful. No invented extra ninth component, characters, boxes, environments or machinery. Plain neutral background, generous separation, useful 3D production reference presentation rather than poster art.
Shapes: FLOOR flat 1.2m square slab with a calm broad seam, no grate or step. WALL plain tall rectangular panel 1.2m wide and 4m high with band at matching height front and back; keep closed flat ends. DOOR FRAME open-bottom squared U shape with no threshold, clear opening 3.2m wide and 3.3m high in a 3.8m by 4m outer frame; dark thin facings within existing volume, no door leaf. CEILING a flat 1.2m square underside tile and one straight short rectangular beam profile, no hanging appendages. CORNER is a narrow square-section 4m-high joint post, END is a narrower flat 4m-high cap, not an L-shaped room. LAMP a compact 0.6m-wide rectangular wall-mounted housing with separate flat amber luminous face. SIGN a thin 1.2m by 0.6m wall plate reading verbatim "WAREHOUSE" and an arrow. EMPTY RACK an open 2.4m-wide, 2.4m-high, 0.6m-deep frame, exactly TWO dark shelf levels and rust-red supports, completely empty.
No dimensions printed: the numbers constrain source proportions only. Labels printed exactly as listed, clean and readable. Wall corner/frame bands align as assembly references. End surfaces and back mounting faces must be visible in secondary views. Rear lamp/sign views have simple flat mounting faces; do not add wiring devices.
PSX industrial space-delivery game: large angular silhouettes, matte flat shading, restrained pixel textures, mainly quiet ivory; minimal coarse wear on lower edges/touched areas, graphite trims and rust-red band. Reduce the mottled grime density from image 2 further on broad surfaces. Keep the floor quieter than the entrance. No gloss, bloom, depth-of-field, microdetail, pipes, lattice clutter or loaded cargo racks.
This is a coherent appearance proposal for human review; not a diagram claiming measured geometry, not production textures and not a Unity screenshot.

components_correction.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit this production appearance sheet. Change ONLY cell 8 EMPTY RACK: remove the middle horizontal shelf from the large isometric rack and the FRONT, SIDE and BACK small views. The rack must have exactly TWO shelf surfaces, one low shelf and one upper shelf, with a large empty vertical gap between them. Both levels are dark graphite, same rust-red corner supports; the top view stays a single dark rectangular shelf surface. Keep the rack empty.
Preserve all other cells 1 through 7, all labels and text, panel layout, palette, material textures and geometry unchanged. Do not redraw the board or add anything. No new words or objects.
